adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a race condition in the webhook handler. Looking at lines 62-78 in app-credential.ts, the code does a findFirst to check if a credential exists, then either updates or creates based on the result. If two concurrent webhook requests arrive for the same userId/appId combination, both could execute findFirst before either reaches the create branch, resulting in duplicate credentials being created. This is a classic TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use) race condition. The code should use upsert or a unique constraint with proper error handling instead of separate find-then-create logic.
